items.stem: 자연스러운 대화가 되도록 <보기>의 ⓐ~ⓓ를 올바르게 배열한 것은?
items.box:
Chris: Yunseo, our field trip is tomorrow. How are we going to go to Central Park?
Yunseo: We can get there by bus or by subway, Chris.
Chris: I prefer the bus to the subway.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
<보기>
ⓐ Chris: Because the bus is faster. It takes only 40 minutes to get to Central Park by bus.
ⓑ Yunseo: Oh, why is that?
ⓒ Yunseo: I don't agree with you. The bus is not faster during rush hour.
ⓓ Chris: Oh, really?
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Yunseo: Yeah, it'll take more than an hour. The subway is much faster during that time.
Chris: I think you're right. Let's take the subway together.
items.explain: 버스를 더 좋아한다 → 왜 그러니?(ⓑ) → 버스가 더 빠르기 때문(ⓐ) → 동의하지 않아, 혼잡 시간엔 안 빠르다(ⓒ) → 정말?(ⓓ) → 한 시간 넘게 걸린다.

box.title: <보기>
lines: ㄱ. Music can make you happily.
ㄴ. I left the classroom dark.
ㄷ. Do you know made who this cake?
ㄹ. This fan keeps the room cool.
ㅁ. Who do you think is the man?
ㅂ. I wonder what did he say to the teacher yesterday.

choices: ㄱ, ㄹ
ㄴ, ㅁ
ㄴ, ㄹ, ㅁ
ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅂ
ㄴ, ㄹ, ㅁ, ㅂ
items.explain: ㄱ happily → happy(make+목적어+형용사). ㄷ Do you know who made this cake?(의문사가 주어인 간접의문문). ㅂ what he said(간접의문문 어순). ㄴ leave+목적어+형용사, ㄹ keep+목적어+형용사, ㅁ think류 동사는 의문사를 문장 맨 앞에 둔다.
items.source: 통합본 L5 GRAMMAR p.26 어법 문장 01·03·04·10·15·08

items.box:
Lily: Dad, I want to use the air fryer.
Dad: The air fryer? What do you want to do with it, Lily?
Lily: I'd like to bake sweet potatoes. How do I use the air fryer?
Dad: It's simple. First, put some sweet potatoes in the air fryer.
Lily: Okay, I did. What's next?
Dad: Then, turn the round button to set the temperature to 200°C.
Lily: 200°C, anything else?
Dad: Lastly, set the time to 20 minutes and press the start button.
Lily: Oh, it's easy.
Dad: Right. ______________(A)______________
Lily: I see. Thanks, Dad.
choices: Don't forget to use oven gloves when you take them out.
You should be careful not to take the wrong bus.
First, put some sweet potatoes in the air fryer.
Then, mix them with tomato sauce, and add a little salt.
Don't forget to take the train on time.
items.explain: 에어프라이어 사용법을 다 설명한 뒤 마지막 당부 — 꺼낼 때 오븐 장갑을 잊지 말라는 말이 자연스럽다.

choices:
A: Which do you prefer, math or English?
B: I prefer math to English.

A: Do you like to travel with plans?
B: Yes, I do. I can save time and energy with plans.

A: Do you know how to cook tomato spaghetti?
B: Sure. First, cook spaghetti noodles.

A: Which do you prefer, red or yellow?
B: I don't agree with you. Yellow is cuter.

A: Excuse me, how can I use this bike?
B: It's simple. First, sign up for our app.
items.explain: 어느 것을 더 좋아하는지 물었는데 '동의하지 않는다'로 답해 어색하다. → I prefer red to yellow. 등

lines: Do you love sports? If you do, you can have a career in sports. Let's meet some people who are working in the sports field.
Reporter: Hello, Ms. Ali. Can you tell me why you became a sports journalist?
Ms. Ali: Well, I've always had a passion for sports and writing. Writing about sports ⓐ<u>makes me excited</u>.
Reporter: There was a big baseball game yesterday. How did you spend the day?

Ms. Ali: I arrived at the baseball park early. Before the game started, I had an interview with the players. I took a lot of notes during the game. After the game, I went to the press conference with other journalists. I asked the players how they felt about the game. In the afternoon, I had to write an article and edit it very quickly. My article was posted online. I love writing about sports.

items.stem: Ms. Ali에 대한 설명으로 올바르지 <u>않은</u> 것은?
choices: She has always had a passion for sports and writing.
She had an interview with the players before the game.
She took a lot of notes during the game.
She went to the press conference alone after the game.
Her article was posted online.
items.explain: 기자 회견에는 다른 기자들과 함께 갔다(with other journalists).

items.stem: <보기>에서 윗글의 ⓐ와 문법적으로 성격이 같은 것<u>만</u>으로 짝지어진 것은?

box.title: <보기>
lines: ㄱ. The sad story made him upset.
ㄴ. They made the visitors a simple map.
ㄷ. His explanation made the lesson clear.
ㄹ. The warm sunlight made the room bright.
ㅁ. Someone made a copy of the picture with bad comments.
ㅂ. We made a good deal on the car.

choices: ㄱ, ㄴ, ㄷ
ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ
ㄴ, ㅁ, ㅂ

items.explain: ⓐ는 「make+목적어+형용사(목적격 보어)」 5형식. ㄱ·ㄷ·ㄹ이 같다. ㄴ은 4형식(만들어 주다), ㅁ·ㅂ은 3형식(만들다/하다).
items.source: 통합본 L5 p.29 13번 문장 · L6 본문 · 학습지 p.1 deal 예문

lines: Are you worried about your digital footprint? Do you want to erase it? If you do, visit Happy Digital Laundry. We can clean your online history. Leave a message on our website, and we'll help you soon.
remove_all_plz

Hi, I'm Bella. Last Friday, I saw my brother playing basketball after school. He was playing really well, so I took a picture of him. ____ⓐ____ I shared it on my social media. ____ⓑ____ the weekend, something went wrong. Someone made a copy of the picture with bad comments. The copy was spread here and there, and I was so embarrassed. My brother wanted me to delete the picture of him. I apologized to him, and I deleted my post immediately. ____ⓒ____, the copies still remain online. I want to remove them all. Please help me.

choices: Bella's brother took a picture of her.
Bella posted a photo of her brother on her social media with bad comments.
Someone made a copy of the picture with bad comments.
Bella's brother wanted her to keep the picture.
Bella refused to delete the picture even after her brother asked her to do so.
items.explain: Bella가 남동생 사진을 찍어 자기 소셜 미디어에 올렸고(나쁜 댓글은 남이 단 복사본에 있었다), 남동생은 삭제를 원했으며, Bella는 바로 게시물을 지웠다. ②·⑤는 통합본 T/F 문장(F).
items.source: L6 본문 1대목 Bella · 통합본 L6 p.38 T/F 문장

items.explain: 사진을 찍은 '그다음'(Then) 공유했고, '주말 동안'(Over the weekend) 문제가 생겼으며, 게시물을 지웠지만 '하지만'(However) 복사본은 남아 있다.

choices: I want you to apologizes to me.
We heard the timer beeps twice.
The doctor told he to exercise every day.
The man told his son to turn off the lights.
The coach ordered the players moving faster.
items.explain: ① to apologize ② beep/beeping(지각동사+목적어+동사원형/-ing) ③ told him ⑤ to move(order+목적어+to부정사).
items.source: 통합본 L6 GRAMMAR p.26 어법 문장 01·04·11·16·18

lines: Happy_Digital_Laundry

We ____ⓐ____ all the copies online, but some copies may ____ⓑ____ on personal devices. If you see the copies again, please contact us. When you share things online, be careful. Remember that sharing something online is easy, but removing it is hard.

choices: Did Happy Digital Laundry completely erase every copy from all devices?
Can some copies of the picture still exist on some people's phones?
How long did it take to remove the copies?
Does Happy Digital Laundry think that sharing something online is easy?
Does the company advise people to think carefully before uploading things online?
items.explain: ① 아니다(개인 기기에 남을 수 있다) ② 그렇다 ④ 그렇다(쉽다, 지우기는 어렵다) ⑤ 그렇다(공유할 때 조심하라). 삭제에 걸린 시간은 나오지 않는다. ①·②·④·⑤는 통합본 T/F·선지 문장을 의문문으로 바꾼 것.
items.source: L6 본문 2대목 Laundry 답장 1 · 통합본 L6 p.38 T/F · 실전모의고사 21번 선지

items.explain: 주어 We가 복사본을 '삭제한' 것이므로 능동 removed. 조동사 may 뒤에는 동사원형 remain.

box.title: Life as a Sports Manager
lines: I am a sports manager for a professional soccer team. I make sure everything goes well and help the team succeed. My job is to give the team the best chance to win. I hire great coaches, manage the office staff, talk to the media, and solve problems.

When I get to the training ground, I talk to the players first. I tell them how well they are doing and encourage them. I make sure they feel ____ⓐ____ and ready for the game. Next, I meet with the head coach to check that everything is on track. We have regular meetings to keep things running ____ⓑ____. In the afternoon, I watch the team train. Watching soccer games and seeing the players ____ⓒ____ is one of the best parts of my job. I enjoy seeing everyone work together as a team.

choices: The writer is a professional soccer player.
The sports manager only meets the head coach on game days.
When I get to the training ground, I talk to the head coach first.
In the afternoon, I watch the team train.
I hire great coaches, manage the office staff, avoid the media, and solve problems.
items.explain: 글쓴이는 선수가 아니라 스포츠 매니저이고, 감독과는 정기 회의를 하며, 훈련장에서는 선수들과 먼저 이야기하고, 언론과도 이야기한다. 오후에 팀 훈련을 지켜본다(원문 그대로). ①·②는 학습지 p.8 T/F 문장, ③·⑤는 본문 한 단어 변형.
items.source: 학습지 p.8 More Reading 'Life as a Sports Manager' · p.8 T/F 문장

items.explain: 선수들을 격려해 '자신감 있고' 준비되게 하고, 회의로 일이 '순조롭게' 돌아가게 하며, 선수들이 '나아지는' 것을 보는 것이 일의 가장 좋은 부분이다.

holds

items.stem: 자연스러운 대화가 되도록 <보기>의 ⓐ~ⓓ를 올바르게 배열한 것은?
items.box:
A: Excuse me, can you tell me how to use this ticket machine?
B: Okay, first, search for the city.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
<보기>
ⓐ B: Lastly, pay and take the ticket.
ⓑ A: I got it. What's next?
ⓒ A: Okay. What should I do after that?
ⓓ B: Second, select the time and seat.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
A: That's easy.
B: Don't forget to take the train on time.
A: Thanks!
items.explain: first → 다음은?(ⓑ) → Second(ⓓ) → 그다음은?(ⓒ) → Lastly(ⓐ).

lines: Hello. Today, I'll introduce a special app, MuzSearch. (A) When you want ⓐ<u>to know</u> the title of a song, this app will help you. (B) First, open the MuzSearch app and touch the search icon. (C) Second, press the microphone icon and wait ⓑ<u>for</u> a while. (D) Then the app will show the title on the screen. If you like the song, don't forget ⓒ<u>pressing</u> the heart icon. (E) The song ⓓ<u>will be saved</u> to your favorites. Try ⓔ<u>it</u> now!

items.explain: don't forget to + 동사원형(~할 것을 잊지 마라) → to press.

items.stem: (A)~(E) 중 <보기>에 주어진 문장의 위치로 가장 적절한 곳은?

box.title: <보기>
lines: It's simple to use.

items.explain: 앱이 도움이 된다는 말 뒤, 사용법(First…)을 늘어놓기 직전에 '사용하기 간단하다'가 온다.

choices: She wonders who are they.
I don't know how did she do it.
Can you tell me what time is it now?
Do you think what he wants to eat?
I wonder how much it will cost.
items.explain: ① who they are ② how she did it ③ what time it is now ④ What do you think he wants to eat?(think류는 의문사를 맨 앞에). ⑤ 의문사+주어+동사 어순이 바르다.

lines: Reporter: Mr. Davis. Do you like your job as a sports agent?
Mr. Davis: Yes. I love sports, and I enjoy ⓐ<u>everything</u> about business. I think my job is perfect for me.
Reporter: Can you tell me more about your job?

Mr. Davis: When my clients have a new contract ⓑ<u>to sign</u>, I check it carefully. I do my best to make the contract ⓒ<u>fairly</u> for them. Also, I often receive phone calls from advertising companies. They want my clients ⓓ<u>in</u> their advertisements. Then, I try ⓔ<u>to get</u> the best deal for my clients.

items.explain: make+목적어+형용사: 계약을 '공정하게' 만들다 → fair. 부사 fairly는 목적격 보어로 쓸 수 없다.

box.title: <보기>
lines: What does Mr. Davis do when his clients have a new contract to sign?

choices: Mr. Davis checks new contracts with care.
Mr. Davis checks contracts quickly without much care.
Mr. Davis often appears in advertisements.
Mr. Davis doesn't pay much attention to the contracts that his clients sign.
Advertising companies want Mr. Davis to appear in their advertisements.

items.source: L5 본문 2대목 Mr. Davis · 통합본 L5 p.39 T/F · p.44 확인문제

lines: Reporter: I want to know why you wanted to be a sports statistician, Ms. Lee.
Ms. Lee: I wanted to be a sports statistician because I liked to analyze sports with numbers. Above all, I love ice hockey.
Reporter: I don't know much about a sports statistician. Can you explain ⓐ<u>it</u> to me?

Ms. Lee: A sports statistician is someone who collects data and studies numbers about sports games. Our team is going to play against the Ice Lions this Saturday. Last week, I carefully watched the Ice Lions' games and analyzed their shots. I found that they let in 70 percent of the shots from the left side. ______________(A)______________ Then, I shared this finding with our players. I'm happy to use my data to help our team.

choices: Ms. Lee liked to analyze sports with numbers.
Ms. Lee carefully watched the Ice Lions' games last week.
The Ice Lions let in 70 percent of the shots from the left side.
Ms. Lee's team is going to play against the Ice Lions this Sunday.
Ms. Lee shared her finding with her players.

choices: This showed their left side was weak.
This showed their left side was strong.
This showed their right side was weak.

Writing about sports makes me excited.

lines: no_more

Hi, I'm Jihun. Last month, I saw an interesting advertisement online. (A)<u>It said that I could get a new smartphone for free.</u> I clicked on it without ⓐ<u>thinking</u> much. (B)<u>Then, I filled out my information to receive the gift.</u> However, instead of getting a new smartphone, I have received useless emails and phone calls from unknown numbers. (C)<u>You can decorate your photos with this app.</u> Oh, my! I just heard my phone ⓑ<u>ringing</u> again. It makes me very ⓒ<u>upset</u>. (D)<u>I'm sure that someone is using my information in a bad way.</u> I think that my personal information ⓓ<u>was shared</u>. I want to delete it. Can you help me, please?
Happy_Digital_Laundry

We checked your online records and found the ad. (E)<u>Then, we asked the ad company ⓔ<u>deleting</u> your information, and they did.</u> To protect your personal information, don't click on ads or links from unknown sources. It can be very dangerous.

items.stem: (A)~(E) 중 글의 흐름상 전체적인 내용과 어울리지 <u>않는</u> 것은?
items.explain: (C)는 사진 꾸미기 앱 소개 문장으로, 개인 정보가 유출된 이야기와 무관하다.
items.source: L6 본문 3·4대목 Jihun · 답장 2 (무관 문장은 L6 Enjoy the Clip B에서 가져옴 — 일부러 넣은 문장)

items.explain: ask+목적어+to부정사: 광고 회사에 정보를 삭제해 '달라고 요청하다' → to delete. ⓑ 지각동사 hear+목적어+-ing, ⓒ make+목적어+형용사, ⓓ 수동태.

choices: Why did Jihun give his information to the ad company?
What kind of problem did Jihun have after clicking the ad?
How many times did the ad company share Jihun's information?
What did Happy Digital Laundry do for Jihun?
How can we protect our personal information online?
items.explain: ① 공짜 스마트폰을 받으려고 ② 쓸모없는 이메일·모르는 번호의 전화 ④ 광고 회사에 정보 삭제 요청 ⑤ 모르는 출처의 광고·링크를 누르지 않기. 정보가 몇 번 공유되었는지는 나오지 않는다. 선지는 통합본 실전모의고사 25번 문장.
items.source: L6 본문 3·4대목 · 통합본 L6 p.63 실전모의고사 25번

lines: Last month, I received an email from an unknown name. I clicked on the link in the email, and a website showed up. I closed the website immediately, but I felt something was wrong. My computer became very slow. I asked the computer store ____ⓐ____ my computer, and they found that someone added bad programs through the link. These programs made my computer ____ⓑ____.

items.explain: ask+목적어+to부정사(점검해 달라고 요청하다) → to check. make+목적어+형용사 → slow.

choices: 민수: The writer clicked on the link in the email, and no website showed up.
지호: The writer closed the website immediately, but he felt something was right.
수아: The writer asked the computer store to check his computer, and they found that someone added bad programs through the link.
하은: The writer asked his friend to check his computer, and they found that someone added bad programs through the link.
준서: The writer asked the computer store to check his computer, and they found that nobody added bad programs through the link.
items.explain: 링크를 누르자 웹사이트가 떴고(①×), 뭔가 잘못되었다고 느꼈으며(②×), 컴퓨터 가게에 점검을 맡겨 누군가 나쁜 프로그램을 심은 것을 찾아냈다(③○, ④·⑤×). 선지는 본문 문장을 3인칭으로 옮기고 한 단어씩 바꾼 것.
